newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Pertamina's Balongan refinery shut Wed - sources.
newsitem.headline: Pertamina's Balongan refinery shut Wed - sources.

text.p: Indonesia's state oil company Pertamina shut down the 125,000-barrels per day (bpd) capacity crude distillation unit (CDU) at its Balongan refinery on Wednesday due to technical problems with the residue catalytic cracker (RCC) unit, Pertamina sources said.

"The CDU was shut on Wednesday because the residue tanks are full. The atmospheric residue hydro demetalizing (ARHDM) unit was also shut. There are no problems with the CDU and ARHDM, but only with the RCC unit," one source said.

Pertamina's junior director of processing, Samto Utomo, said on Tuesday the 83,000-bpd capacity residue catalytic cracker at Balongan had been closed since February 6 due to an unexpected technical problem, and that three weeks were needed for repairs.
Utomo did not reveal the exact nature of the problem, but said attempts to restart the RCC on February 20 failed because of what he only described as "another small problem."
